beats.title: PR Merged Despite Unresolved Nullable Concern
beats.body: The change removing the nullable property was merged on January 11, before the discussion fully surfaced the legitimate use case for null values in credit and debit notes. Post-merge, the team acknowledged the migration script would need a follow-up fix, and a workaround using a hidden sentinel date value was accepted as a stopgap for modules lacking a due date field.

beats.title: Engineering Lessons
lessons: Schema constraints should be validated against all consuming modules, not just the primary use case, before being enforced at the database level.
Reverting a nullable constraint is a breaking migration that can silently corrupt data for edge-case document types already in production.
Workarounds that inject placeholder sentinel values to satisfy validation signal a schema design mismatch that warrants a proper architectural fix.
